## Ambiguous files — verdicts with evidence

### `ControladorAudiencia.cs` vs `ControladorAudienciaPiano` / `ControladorAudienciaSing`

| File | Verdict |
|---|---|
| `ControladorAudiencia.cs` | **CANTO (legacy, still live in SingGame)** — NOT a shared base class. Reads `ScoreManager.Instance.accuracyPercent` (canto scoring). Attached on `_GestorAudiencia` in `SingGame.unity`. Also referenced by `MidiAudioManager` (applause clip fallback, line 513) and disabled by `PianoPublicSystem.EnsureAudienceController()` (lines 427–431). |
| `ControladorAudienciaPiano.cs` | **PIANO** — in `PianoGame.unity`; wired to `PianoPublicSystem`. |
| `ControladorAudienciaSing.cs` | **DEAD** — only created by `SingPublicSystem.EnsureAudienceController()`, but `SingPublicSystem` is never instantiated anywhere. |

The newer canto audience stack (`SingPublicSystem` + `ControladorAudienciaSing`) mirrors piano but is **not wired**; SingGame still uses the old monolithic `ControladorAudiencia`.

### `QuestXRInteractionController.cs` (1463 lines)

**MIXED** — on XR Rig prefab used in all modes. Core VR interaction is shared; piano-specific override at lines 209–222 (`IsHandTrackingEnabledForActiveScene`, `IsPianoGameHandTrackingOverrideEnabled`, `IsControllerOnlyModeEnabledForActiveScene`) disables hand tracking / forces controllers in `PianoGame`.

### `PianoCalibrator.cs` → **PIANO**

Only in `PianoGame.unity`; `PianoGameManager` subscribes to `PianoCalibrator.OnPianoConfigured`.

### `PianoGameManager.cs` → **PIANO**

Only `PianoGame.unity`; orchestrates piano load, scoring, MIDI, results.

### `ResultsPanel.cs` → **PIANO**

Only used by `PianoGameManager` (`ShowResults`, `SaveAndExitToRepertorio`); added at runtime if missing. Canto uses `EndGameManager` instead.

### `EvolutionGraphsController.cs` → **MIXED**

`RepertorioScene.unity`. Dual UI: `pianoScrollView` / `cantoScrollView` (lines 45–46), splits sessions by `IsPiano` (lines 361–362), separate render paths (lines 356–375).

### `ProgressDisplay.cs` → **PIANO**

Only `PianoGame.unity`; binds `PianoGameManager`, `GameplayScoring`, `PianoPublicSystem`, `GameNoteData`.

### `SelectedSongManager.cs` → **SHARED**

`RepertorioScene.unity`; used by `SongItem`, `ShowRepertorio`, `PianoGameManager`, `SongLoader` (both modes).

## Category counts

| Category | Count |
|---|---|
| PIANO | 28 |
| CANTO | 18 |
| SHARED | 32 |
| MIXED | 5 (`SongItem`, `EvolutionGraphsController`, `DetallesSesionUI`, `QuestXRInteractionController`, plus `PianoAudienceIntensityProfile` is shared config despite piano folder) |
| DEAD | 7 (`UDPReceiver`, `HarmonyEngine`, `PlayerSpawnPoint`, `RecenterPlayer`, `ChordDetectorUI`, `SingPublicSystem`, `ControladorAudienciaSing`) |

**Key architectural takeaway:** Canto audience was refactored in code (`SingPublicSystem` / `ControladorAudienciaSing`) but never wired; production canto still runs legacy `ControladorAudiencia`. Piano completed the same refactor (`PianoPublicSystem` / `ControladorAudienciaPiano`) and actively disables the legacy class if present.
